title: Web Follower not working
symptom: The LLU Web Follower is not working in Germany for Libre. It seems that Abbott changed the URL for German accounts from api-eu.libreview.io to api-de.libreview.io. The issue persists even after updating to the latest nightly, and toggling proxy support did not help.
cause: The thread suggests that the German server is not working with Web Follower, possibly due to a missing or incorrect country/api endpoint mapping. The user speculates that Abbott changed the URL for German accounts.
fix: The thread does not provide a definitive fix. A workaround mentioned is setting the country of the Libre users to Switzerland, which made it work. The maintainer suggested updating to the latest nightly and toggling proxy support, but these did not resolve the issue.
evidence_quote: It seems that German server is still not working with Web Follower. I have tried to help someone to use Web Follower with Libre 3, but it wasn't able to pull the data, while LibreLinkUp was working perfectly. The country was Germany of both Libre users (uploader and follower). Because it seems, that some countries have different servers (https://github.com/timoschlueter/nightscout-librelink-up/blob/main/utils/llu-api-endpoints.js) and on them is Germany, we have tried it again with a different Libre account pair (uploader and follower) this time we have set the country of the Libre users to Switzerland and it was working perfectly.
